Summary: S1-01 Restore os-backend and db/migrations
Description: server.js:34-35 unconditionally requires ./os-backend/src/mapping/os_repo.js; commit 094dde1 deleted that tree (83 files). The require is at module top level so it fires in blob mode too. Verified: node -e require('./server.js') fails with Cannot find module. AC: clean clone + npm ci + npm start serves without throwing. NOTE: if the deletion was deliberate this story becomes 'inline the mapper' and re-estimates to 13. Source: docs/workflows/07 section 0.

Summary: S1-02 CI boot smoke test
Description: Nothing in the repo would have caught S1-01. CI job runs require('./server.js') and one /api/version request against a scratch DB, required to merge, failing if map.* or db.* drift counters are non-zero or mig.failed/mig.pending > 0. Source: docs/workflows/07 sections 0 and 10.18.

Summary: S1-03 Fix the accounting/operations permission gate
Description: sbInvoicesPersist:42846 gates on laCanEditArea('accounting') but calls acctPersistBookings:42877 gated on 'operations'. An accounting-only user's invoice saves while the linked booking's invoiceId/paymentStatus/history stay in RAM and are lost on refresh. Same shape: ckPersist accepts 'pier', acctPersistBookings does not. AC: an accounting-only user creates an invoice, reloads, booking still shows invoiced. Add a test that no persist helper may call another with a stricter area. Source: docs/workflows/06 section 10.1 and 03 section 9.8.

Summary: S1-04 Weather reschedule must clear bk.ops
Description: bkV2WeatherResolveOne:60032 moves trip.date without clearing bk.ops boat/van/check-in. bkV2RescheduleBooking:77572 and the edit-path date change :76886 both clear it, so a weather-rescheduled booking silently keeps the previous day's boat and van. Reuse the existing clear rather than writing a third variant; respect bkOpsRead/bkOpsFor per-day semantics. Source: docs/workflows/01 section 7.

Summary: S1-05 Partial cancel must return seat-lock draws
Description: bkV2PartialCancel:77728 reduces pax and money but never returns the corresponding trips[].lockDraws and never touches the invoice. lockDraws (not the used counter) is the source of truth for lock usage, so seats stay consumed against getAllotment forever. Flag the invoice as needing adjustment; do not auto-edit money. Source: docs/workflows/01 sections 7 and 7.6.

Summary: S1-06 Fix esc undefined in the rate-type picker
Description: allotment_v2.html:63867 inside agEditBuildRateTypePicker calls a bare esc(...) in the branch taken whenever the agent has a sales owner. No global esc exists in this file, so the picker throws and renders nothing for most agents. Add a local const esc per file convention and grep every top-level render fn for the same class. Source: docs/workflows/02 section 9.20.

Summary: S1-07 Spike - catalogue every unpersisted write
Description: Four documented instances and likely more: SB_ADDON_SVCS/aosSaveModal:79018 never reads or writes the blob yet a.addonServices[].svcId points into it; ctRenewActivate:65317 mutates contract version/history without sbAgentsPersist(); flSaveAssignment, flCancelAssignment, flAutoUpdateAssignments and fuelSetBudget write localStorage directly instead of via flSave(). Output is a table (mutation site / store / persisted? / lost on reload?) ranked by blast radius - a document, not a fix. Source: docs/workflows/02 sections 9.11 and 9.21, 05 section 10.19.

Summary: S1-08 Stand up the test harness
Description: No test framework is wired for the areas that matter; db/test_seat_lock_race.mjs and db/rt.cjs exist but are not a suite. Needs a runner in CI, ephemeral Postgres per run provisioned from db/migrations (depends on S1-01), one end-to-end proof creating a booking through the real write path and asserting the row in Postgres, and a fixture helper that builds a booking without the DOM.

Summary: S1-09 ARCHITECTURE.md pointing at the workflow docs
Description: CLAUDE.md cites CHANGELOG.md six times; it does not exist and was never tracked in git. README.md says data lives in localStorage - the opposite of the truth - and documents APP_USER/APP_PASS while server.js:19-20 reads ADMIN_USER/ADMIN_PASS. Also fix the start_server.command path and state that it gives you no /api. Source: docs/workflows/07 section 10 drift table.

Summary: S1-10 Backup and restore drill
Description: flListSnapshots()/flRestoreSnapshot(N) are listed in CLAUDE.md section 4 as a live safety system and are dead on the real dataset. Verify the Railway Postgres backup exists and is current, restore into a scratch database, boot the app against it, and write the runbook. If snapshots are truly dead, remove the claim from CLAUDE.md. Source: docs/workflows/07 section 9.7.

Summary: S2-01 Regression suite for the edit-preserve block
Description: bkV2CommitBooking rebuilds newBk from the form; anything not copied in the if(editing) block at :76855 is destroyed. Carry-overs required: history, weatherResolve, rebook, invoiceId, paymentStatus, ops, b2cOverride, upgrades, feeItems, reschedule, partialCancels, cancellation, cancelCategory, resolved approval, decided focApproval. Losing ops once already wiped every boat/van assignment. One test per field, data-driven from a single list; delete a carry-over line and confirm the suite goes red. Source: docs/workflows/01 section 7.1.

Summary: S2-02 Seat-lock and allotment invariant tests
Description: Interlocking rules needing protection: children contribute 0 to the pool (bkV2LockPoolHold:41783); month locks use rolling per-trip release not a global expiry (:41696); lockDraws is truth not used; over-capacity pendings hold no seats (bkPendHoldsSeat:12040); charter never consumes seats. Cover the hard-block vs soft-confirm split at :76672 and the cancelled-status exclusion across all six aggregate sites. Source: docs/workflows/01 sections 7.2-7.7 and 7.12.

Summary: S2-03 Single source of truth for cancelled statuses
Description: The triple ['cancelled','cancelled_weather','rejected'] is duplicated as a literal roughly ten times, and ACCT_PAID_STATES is the same list under a misleading name. One exported constant, rename to ACCT_EXCLUDED_STATES, plus a lint rule or test failing on a new inline literal. Source: docs/workflows/03 section 9.15 and 06 section 10.2.

Summary: S2-04 Make the four-registration trap loud
Description: A new persisted field needs the persist helper, both client load paths, field_mapping.json and operation_schemas_model.json, plus a real column. Miss any one and the data silently disappears. Build a drift check that fails CI when a model field has no mapping entry or a mapping entry has no column - restoring the capability of the deleted check_mapping_drift.js - plus an npm script scaffolding all registrations, and commit the ops.pierNote worked example into the repo. Source: docs/workflows/07 sections 4 and 10.5.

Summary: S2-05 Fix or document the three revert-to-seed stores
Description: pier_lic_types, pier_lic_classes and pier_codes load with Array.isArray(x) && x.length, so clearing the list reverts it to seed - breaking the deliberate rule that an empty array stays empty. Determine whether it is intentional, then either drop the .length guard or comment it as deliberate at all three sites. Source: docs/workflows/07 section 10.6.

Summary: S2-06 trips hardcoded per-boat columns
Description: trips maps to b1_route, b1_type, b1_booked, b1_charterbookingid and so on per boat. b8/b14/b15 were missing from the start and their assignments vanished on sync (server.js:1637-1644). Spike first (normalize to a child table vs generate columns from BOATS); whichever wins, adding a boat must require zero schema edits and the migration must preserve existing bN_* data. Source: docs/workflows/07 section 10.12.

Summary: S2-07 Disambiguate the two save() functions
Description: Two unrelated save() functions exist and the wrong one is easy to call. flSave() also persists BOATS because fleet mutates b.log constantly and the sales-side save() is never called from there. Rename to intent-revealing names, document why flSave() owns BOATS, and test that a boat status change made from the fleet UI survives a reload. Source: docs/workflows/07 section 1.3 and 05 section 10.1.

Summary: S3-01 Remove demo seeders from the boot path
Description: _seedContractExpiryVariety():39725 force-sets contractEnd on agents a01/a10/a30 to today+25 days and expires a40 on every boot, relative to a hard-coded 2026-09-02, against whatever data is loaded. SB_AGENT_PRICES is regenerated from _seedAgentPrices():39914 every boot and never persisted, so the renewal snapshot at :65332 records synthetic prices. IMPORTANT ordering: audit whether production contract dates are already corrupted BEFORE shipping the fix, since the fix removes the evidence. Source: docs/workflows/02 sections 9.22-9.23.

Summary: S3-02 Order-driven cost lines
Description: Documented incident at :56152-56153: a 35-pax boat with 2 real longtail-join customers was costed at the per-head formula rate times all 35 heads - 17x over. ctOdQty/pxLongtail exist to feed real ordered quantity into ctCalc for od:true lines. Audit every cost line for a missing od:true, add a test reproducing the 35-pax/2-order case asserting 2x not 35x, and make od the default for anything longtail/charter/van shaped. Source: docs/workflows/06 section 10.12.

Summary: S3-03 Trip P&L trustworthiness signals
Description: A trip with no Costing plan still computes zero cost rather than refusing; nNoPlan is the only signal the profit figure is meaningless. Trip P&L revenue is also independent of invoicing - tsTripAmount reads the frozen booking price and never consults SB_INVOICES/SB_PAYMENTS - so P&L and the Accounting Outstanding KPI answer different questions and will never reconcile. Mark day totals containing an unplanned boat; state on both screens what they measure. Source: docs/workflows/06 sections 10.8 and 10.10.

Summary: S3-04 Invoice lifecycle gaps
Description: Three holes. inv.whtAmount is read by acctInvoiceDocHtml:59202 but nothing anywhere writes it, so every printed invoice shows a zero withholding-tax line regardless of reality - a compliance question for finance, not a display bug. acctVoidInvoice sets status='void' but leaves SB_PAYMENTS rows in place so voiding does not reverse the cash. acctRecordPayment does not cap payment at the invoice balance and the excess becomes agent credit nowhere. Source: docs/workflows/06 sections 10.3, 10.5 and 10.6.

Summary: S3-05 Pricing layer inconsistencies
Description: Add-ons are priced from the base rate (bkV2AddOnInfo:77190 calls bkV2GetRT()) while seats and FOC use bkV2GetRTForTrip(), so a promo changing longtail prices silently does not apply - latent, harmless only because no promos exist yet. Rate validity dates never gate a price: an expired rate still prices a booking and only active===false removes it from pickers. A paid bundle suppresses longtail-join for the whole booking rather than per trip. Fix the promo/base mismatch before any promo ships. Source: docs/workflows/02 sections 9.2, 9.3 and 9.8.

Summary: S3-06 Timezone sweep
Description: bkV2LocalYMD is the rule but several paths still use toISOString().slice(0,10) and land on the previous day before 07:00 ICT: bkV2CommitBooking createdAt/bookingDate at :76704 and :76844, drDateShift:52758, psuResolveProfile:40327 and psuOpenCloneProfile:40763. Replace all occurrences, add a lint rule banning the pattern, and add a test executing at 00:30 ICT. Source: docs/workflows/01 section 7.8, 03 section 9.13, 04 section 9.

Summary: S3-07 Missing status labels
Description: bkV2StatusLabel:69213 has no entry for pending_approval or cancelled_weather; both render as the raw status string in the UI. Source: docs/workflows/01 section 7.

Summary: B-01 bkV2InferZone reads a v1-only field
Description: bkV2InferZone:69054 reads bk.pickup, a v1 field the v2 form never writes, so calendar zone splits are effectively all PK for v2 bookings. Source: docs/workflows/01 section 7.

Summary: B-02 ckWrite drops fields outside CK_STAGE_KEYS
Description: ckWrite rebuilds the whole check-in object; anything not listed in CK_STAGE_KEYS:47238 is lost on the next plus/minus press. That is why arrivedAt, clearedAt and reinstate are listed there. Source: docs/workflows/03 section 9.6.

Summary: B-03 pjOf field whitelist silently drops new fields
Description: pjOf has a field whitelist at :82102-82104. A new per-day job-sheet field not added there is silently dropped on the next pjSet. Source: docs/workflows/03 section 9.7.

Summary: B-04 Audit direct bk.ops reads
Description: bk.ops is day 1 only; reads must go through bkOpsRead/bkOpsFor with an explicit date. Any dispatch screen reading bk.ops directly is wrong for overnight and multi-programme bookings, and every OVN bug in these domains traces back to a direct access. Source: docs/workflows/03 section 9.1 and 04 section 9.

Summary: B-05 Deposit application has no locking
Description: acctApplyDeposit recomputes remaining fresh each call by summing existing payment rows, so two concurrent applications against the same deposit can both read stale remaining and jointly over-draw it. Source: docs/workflows/06 section 10.7.

Summary: B-06 A booking can be invoiced before it is confirmed
Description: acctNewInvoiceRender's un-invoiced-bookings filter only excludes the three cancelled-family statuses, so a quote or pending_approval booking can be picked into an invoice. Source: docs/workflows/06 section 10.14.

Summary: B-07 flProjMarkComplete bypasses flMaintClose
Description: flProjMarkComplete bypasses flMaintClose for its children: no outcome, no asset status restore, no repairHistory, no incident auto-close. Source: docs/workflows/05 section 10.17.

Summary: B-08 flUpdateAssignEngInfo uses the wrong service formula
Description: flUpdateAssignEngInfo:36278 still uses the old modulo for the service countdown instead of measuring against lastServiceHours. Source: docs/workflows/05 section 10.9.

Summary: B-09 rtSaveDraft leaves orphaned route references
Description: rtSaveDraft prunes orphaned seatRates and charterRates but not routeValidity, routeBundles or addOns.*.applies, which keep pointing at removed routes. Source: docs/workflows/02 section 9.15.

Summary: B-10 rtDeleteRT leaves agents with no price
Description: rtDeleteRT detaches every bound agent by deleting a.rateTypeId; the agents survive with no price. Source: docs/workflows/02 section 9.17.

Summary: B-11 Rate-type price edits are not versioned
Description: Rate-type price edits have no version history at all. agLog caps activity[] at 200 and is the only audit trail; the documented workaround is Clone rather than in-place edit. Source: docs/workflows/02 section 9.19.

Summary: B-12 Nothing blocks an under-licensed crew
Description: plBoatBad:81899 is advisory only - no hard block exists on sailing with an under-licensed crew. Source: docs/workflows/03 section 9.17.

Summary: B-13 Re-confirm has no permission guard
Description: Re-confirm has no permission guard on its writers; it relies on acctPersistBookings refusing. If a stricter persist path is added, the guard must be added too. Source: docs/workflows/03 section 9.19.

Summary: B-14 devlogIsAdmin returns true with no session
Description: devlogIsAdmin() returns true when there is no LA_ME at all, so the degraded localhost-without-/api path gets full System Log access with no login. Harmless for a dev dataset; matters if that path is ever pointed at real data. Source: docs/workflows/08 section 11.

Summary: B-15 Modularize allotment_v2.html
Description: 83629 lines in one file with one global scope. Spike the split first - domain boundaries are already mapped by docs/workflows 01-08. Source: docs/workflows/08 section 1.

Summary: B-16 _baChMemo lifetime blocks async rendering
Description: _baChMemo lives exactly one microtask (:45332) and is safe only because rendering is synchronous. Any move to async rendering must revisit it. Source: docs/workflows/03 section 9.4.

Summary: B-17 admin_devlog is double-encoded JSON
Description: devlogLoad/devlogSave JSON.parse and JSON.stringify a second time on top of the blob's own serialization, making admin_devlog a double-encoded string rather than a real collection. A new persisted dev-tool field should not copy this shape. Source: docs/workflows/08 section 11.

Summary: B-18 _bindVal coercion is silent
Description: _bindVal (server.js:114) coerces bad scalars rather than letting them wedge a batch - empty string into a bigint becomes NULL, 3.6 into a bigint rounds. The behaviour is deliberate but silent; surface these instead of swallowing them. Source: docs/workflows/07 section 10.13.

Summary: B-19 fast_import does not bump app_state.version
Description: fast_import does not bump app_state.version, so open clients never notice an import and need a hard refresh. Source: docs/workflows/07 section 10.15.

Summary: B-20 DATA_VERSION is written but never checked
Description: DATA_VERSION is written at :5790 but never read. Re-arming it is a migration, not a version bump. Source: docs/workflows/07 section 10.8.

Summary: B-21 Three incompatible location vocabularies
Description: SPARE_LOC_LABELS/FL_STASH_LOCS keys for parts, WAREHOUSE_LOCATIONS plain Thai strings for inventory, and free-text ENG_LOCS for engines do not interoperate. Source: docs/workflows/05 section 10.15.

Summary: B-22 Two coexisting boat-status fields
Description: m.boatStatus (new) and m.setFixing (legacy boolean) coexist and must always be read together as m.boatStatus || (m.setFixing===false ? 'available' : 'fixing'). Source: docs/workflows/05 section 10.4.

Summary: B-23 No one-click re-install of a stashed part
Description: There is no one-click path to put a stashed gearbox or propeller back onto an engine; the workaround is the edit form. Source: docs/workflows/05 section 10.24.

Summary: B-24 Job orders depend on CDN availability
Description: PNG export lazy-loads html2canvas from a CDN (_vjEnsureH2C:55149) and the pickup map lazy-loads Leaflet plus Carto tiles. Offline at the pier means no job order. Source: docs/workflows/04 section 9.

Summary: B-25 Doc-Check OCR constraints
Description: OCR needs the internet, reads English only, never reads MRZ, and fuzzy-matches six fields. Auto-ticks are a hint only. Source: docs/workflows/03 section 9.18.

Summary: B-26 /api/load ships the whole blob
Description: /api/load ships the entire blob and its cache invalidates on every write, which is why it uses brotli q5 rather than q11. Do not raise the compression level as an optimisation. Source: docs/workflows/07 section 10.16.

Summary: B-27 Reconcile remaining documentation drift
Description: Twelve documented drift items remain in docs/workflows/07 section 10, spanning README.md, SYSTEM_MAP.md, CLAUDE.md, .railwayignore, tools/apply-migration.js and HANDOFF_2026-07-04.md.

Summary: B-28 CLAUDE.md lists ranong as planned
Description: CLAUDE.md:51 lists pier ranong as Planned, but the code has full first-class support - 98 references and a complete Pier-Office view family. Source: docs/workflows/08 section 11.

Summary: B-29 Stale booking comments and spec
Description: The _bkV2 state comment at :68863 says 3 tabs when there are 6, and docs/BOOKING.md is a stale Phase-1 spec with line numbers roughly 35k off. docs/booking.model.ts is accurate. Source: docs/workflows/01 section 7.13.

Summary: B-30 Table count mismatch in HANDOFF
Description: HANDOFF_2026-07-04.md says 107 tables; the data dictionary and operation_schemas_structure.sql both say 103. Source: docs/workflows/07 section 10 drift table.

Summary: B-31 Normalize NoTransfer vs NT
Description: Both spellings of the no-transfer zone are live across the codebase and every test must cover both. Source: docs/workflows/04 section 9.

Summary: B-32 Decorative fake QR on invoices
Description: _acctFauxQR:59187 renders deterministic pixels seeded from the invoice number - a purely visual fake QR, not a real PromptPay code. Remove it or make it real. Source: docs/workflows/06 section 10.4.

Summary: B-33 Standardize the local esc convention
Description: esc/escapeHTML is not global; every renderer declares its own. Most fleet renderers inline template values unescaped. A new top-level renderer without a local esc throws silently on click. Source: docs/workflows/05 section 10.22 and 08 section 5.1.

Summary: B-34 Document per-device sidebar prefs
Description: Sidebar and layout prefs (la_sbcolor_*, la_sbacc_*, la_pogrp, sb_collapsed) are per-device by design and never sync. Document this so it is not 'fixed' into a bug. Source: docs/workflows/08 section 11.
